embeds.title: 👀  What 1.5.0 looks like
embeds.description: **The button.** Left-click opens Game Plan. Right-click opens this menu. Hover it and it tells you what each click does.

fields.name: 1️⃣  Game Plan
fields.value: Your own checklist. Tick steps off, reorder with the arrows, x to remove. The gold arrow points at your next stop and shows how far it is.

fields.name: 2️⃣  Party tab
fields.value: Quests you and your group both have, in order. **+ Plan** drops one into your Game Plan. Tick the box to skip it.

fields.name: 3️⃣  Share tab
fields.value: Every quest your party has that you don't. Hit **Ask** and it gets shared to you. No typing, nothing in chat.

fields.name: 4️⃣  Dungeons
fields.value: Right-click, then Dungeons. Tick the ones you want to run and guildies in range get a heads-up.

footer: Party and Share only see people who also run Guild Board  ·  For the Horde
